mission_04: Excellent! You have mastered hyperparameter tuning across entire sklearn pipelines. By using the step__parameter naming convention, you can optimize any parameter from any pipeline step simultaneously, finding the best combination of preprocessing and modeling choices. GridSearchCV handles cross-validation correctly, ensuring that each fold is processed independently to prevent data leakage. The results show how different preprocessing choices interact with model hyperparameters, revealing that the optimal configuration often involves trade-offs between feature engineering complexity and model capacity. This approach is the gold standard for model optimization in sklearn and should be your default method for finding the best pipeline configuration for any dataset.
